artifact_inventory.description: Exact-rational implementation of the 2-adic peeling formulas and deterministic finite checks.

limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The index n is given, no efficient factorization claim is made, exact integer/rational arithmetic is required, and direct fingerprints may have exponential subset complexity. The motivating preprint is very recent, so contemporaneous unindexed work remains a residual originality risk. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
record_title: Exact 2-adic peeling from a single cyclotomic value
scientific_context: An exact rational 2-adic recursion that recovers every distinct prime divisor of an index from one cyclotomic value Phi_n(2), complementing local least-prime extractors and real-logarithmic complete peeling.
